result:
All 12 tests pass (the 6 original checks plus the new ones). Verified the new tests fail on the pre-fix code (rotate deleted the newest archive when `total == keep`; verify split `my backup…` at the blank and reported `BAD my (archive missing)`; the text sort ranked 9999 above 10000), and smoke-tested that every flag (`--help`, `=`-forms, `--keep` validation, `-n`, `-l`, `--top`, `--no-header`, `--target`, `--`) still behaves as before the refactor.

The fixes:
- **rotate.sh** — `--keep N` with exactly N archives proceeded past the guard (`-lt` → `-le`), and `surplus()` used `tail -n +N` on the oldest-first list, deleting the newest entries; it now deletes the oldest `total - keep` entries with `head -n`.
- **verify.sh** — took the archive name from the sidecar's content by splitting on blanks, which broke on spaces; per DESIGN.md §4.3 it now takes only the digest from the sidecar and identifies the archive by the sidecar's own name minus `.sha256`.
- **report.sh** — `sort -r` compared sizes as text; now `sort -t $'\t' -k1,1nr` sorts numerically on the size column.
- **lib/common.sh** — new file owning the option parser (`parse_options`) and `resolve_dir`, sourced by all five scripts.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `report.sh` (bug fixes), all five scripts (source `lib/common.sh`), new `lib/common.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh` (3 new tests), and `docs/DESIGN.md` + `README.md` (doc text describing the duplicated block that no longer exists).
